plan.scope: exploratory existing-label interaction, not actual corridor memory or entry P&L
plan.question: Do original-anchor trend/momentum direction signs add selective excursion reach within prior wide-range and fast-wide contexts?
plan.context_definition: At confirmed-exit proxy ONLY, compare exported dir with exported trend sign (prior500bars) and sign(mom100_h) (prior100bars), both measured at original t0, NOT updated exit-time or spatial corridor activity. Either zero => neutral; otherwise both same/opposite or mixed.
plan.population: pos0 observed exits, O2resolved to exactly match prior excursion study; retest rates use own label denominator within same population and bounds retain uncertainty
plan.weights: equal global session/contract/anchor/row within ALL exits of block, then restriction. Equal mean3blockrates, no averaging contexts without masses.
plan.cuts: reuse O2-trained delay/range terciles, no refit/new cut selection
plan.support: all contexts/controls/folds/contracts retained; no threshold on support used to delete rows
plan.limitations: Old covariates may be stale at exit; no timestamps of retest or price path; no genuine recent traversability, acceptance/rejection or corridor peaks; no blind confirmation/causal controls/quality promotion.
plan.next_actual_corridor_test: Record previous traversal efficiency, direction-specific revisit/rejection and confirmed obstacles inside forward price corridor using data known before each decision; must have prices/time and as-of geometry. These features are hypotheses, not measured here.
plan.post_exposure_extension: After seeing MIXED parent rates, split it into two directional mechanisms before examining their outcomes. Exploratory, not preregistered or blind.

profile_resolution: Same exact previously profiled exports, selected16 columns no nulls; duplicates preserved sharing anchor weights, not independent. Labels finite/integer checked; partition/state semantics explicit. No new raw prices.

comparison_plan.finding: Opposing short momentum with exit-aligned long sign has higher global reach; neutral low support, other conflict not equivalent
comparison_plan.reason: Keep all disjoint contexts plus parent separately, thresholds and coverage
